      "supporting_evidence_ids": ["obs_1"],
      "limitations": "Does not rule out subject-specific mappings or identity effects."
    },

      "id": "H2",
      "claim": "The model exploits subject/session identities (identity/collection effects) rather than trial content.",
      "mechanism": "Labels are partially determined by the subject or session ID, allowing high performance when test data shares these IDs with training data (window split), but failing on subject-split where subjects are unseen.",
      "supporting_evidence_ids": ["obs_1"],
      "limitations": "Does not rule out trial-specific signatures."
    }
  ],
